Composition/framing: 7:12 portrait canvas; full body; character centered near the bottom with both feet on the bottom baseline; headroom matching references; right-facing side/three-quarter profile

Color palette: muted hospital gray, faded white, charcoal, skin tones; muted orange only for the tiny pin
Constraints: exact canvas 672x1152; no floor, no shadow, no scenery; background must be pure uniform #00FF00; do not use any green or lime on the character; one character only; no readable text, numbers, logos, signature, or watermark
Avoid: anti-aliased/vector-smooth edges, high-detail pixel art, painterly rendering, extra props, exaggerated expression, left-facing pose
